According to The Economist and YouGov, more people disapprove than approve of Trump’s job performance in 47 out of 50 states and in the District of Columbia. The three states where the majority of respondents still approve of the president are Wyoming (+14), Idaho (+9), and West Virginia (+6).

All three went for Trump in the 2016, 2020, and 2024 presidential elections. [...] # Trump's job approval is negative in all 50 states except these three

# Trump's approval rating hits yet another record low in latest poll

Portrait of Fernando Cervantes Jr.

President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to yet another low since his return to the White House, according to a new Economist/YouGov poll, which also found that just 1 in 3 Americans approve of his job performance. [...] The survey, released Aug. 11, found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump’s performance, down 3 percentage points from the previous week. This marks the lowest approval rating the president has seen in YouGov tracking since he returned to office in 2025.
results.title: Trump's approval rating hits yet another record low in latest poll
